course_name_original: Cálculo, Diseño y Ensayo de Máquinas
course_name_en: Calculation, Design, and Testing of Machines

learning_outcomes.text: Able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.
Identify different machine elements and understand their operation within the context of a machine.
Able to select bearings and plain bearings for a machine according to its technical specifications.
Calculate and choose the appropriate flexible transmission for a machine according to its design parameters.
Know and apply the finite element method to the sizing of machine elements by performing simulation practices.

syllabus_topics: Calculation, design, and testing of elements and machines.
The product development cycle: design, analysis, and testing.
Theory and practice of the finite element method.
Application of the finite element method to mechanical analysis.

assessment_methods.method: Group work TG1: selection of chains
Group work TG3: selection of bearings

assessment_rules: There will be two general continuous assessment grades, C1 (first semester) and C2 (second semester). To average C1 and C2, each must be greater than 3.5, and the average must be 5.0 or higher for approval by continuous assessment. C1 is calculated as 80% exams and 20% assignments from the first semester. C2 is an average of C2T (80% exams and 20% assignments from the second semester) and C2P (lab practices); a minimum of 3 points in both C2T and C2P is required to average C2. For the ordinary call exam, students taking both theoretical and practical parts will have their grade as 100% of the exam score. Students with C2P >= 5 who only take the theoretical part will have a grade of 75% of the theoretical exam score plus 25% of C2P. Students with (C1*0.6 + C2T*0.4) >= 5 who only take the practical part will have a grade of 75% of the practical exam score plus 25% of (C1*0.6 + C2T*0.4). For the extraordinary exam, the grade will be 100% of the exam score, and no previously approved parts will be carried over.
